ask: a counter: a label shows the count, starting at 0; a button labelled + adds one and a button labelled - takes one away, below 0 too
check:
# A counter: 0 at first, + adds one, - takes one away.
expect number = 0
expect not number = 1
repeat 3: click "+"
expect number = 3
click "-|−"
expect number = 2
expect not number = 3
click "-|−"
click "-|−"
click "-|−"
expect number = -1

ask: a tip calculator: a text input for the bill in whole dollars, buttons labelled 10%, 15% and 20% that choose the tip, and labels showing the tip and the total in whole dollars, rounded down (a bill of 200 at 15% shows a tip of 30 and a total of 230)
check:

type 1 "200"
click "15%"
expect number = 30
expect number = 230
click "20%"
expect number = 40
expect number = 240
expect not number = 30
type 1 "99"
click "10%"
expect number = 9
expect number = 108
type 1 "57"
click "15%"
expect number = 8
expect number = 65

ask: a stopwatch: buttons labelled Start, Stop and Reset, and the time shown as seconds and tenths, like 12.3, counting with every 100; Stop keeps the time, Start goes on from it, Reset sets it to 0.0
check:
# A stopwatch: seconds and tenths; Start, Stop (keeps the time), Start again, Reset.
expect says "0.0"
click "Start"
wait 2500
expect says "2.5"
click "Stop"
wait 1000
expect says "2.5"
click "Start|Resume"
wait 1000
expect says "3.5"
wait 9000
expect says "12.5"
click "Stop"
click "Reset"
expect says "0.0"
expect not says "12.5"

ask: a todo list: a text input and a button labelled Add that adds what is typed as a new task at the end of the list (nothing when the input is empty); each task shows its text and, until it is done, a button labelled Done that checks it off; a label says how many tasks are not done yet, like 2 left
check:
# A todo list: Add adds what is typed (nothing when empty); Done checks a task off.
expect says "0 left"
type 1 "milk"
click "Add"
expect says "milk"
expect says "1 left"
type 1 "eggs"
click "Add"
expect says "eggs"
expect says "milk"
expect says "2 left"
type 1 ""
click "Add"
expect says "2 left"
click "Done"
expect says "1 left"
type 1 "tea"
click "Add"
expect says "tea"
expect says "2 left"

ask: snake on a 10 x 10 board, pixels on a canvas, a grid widget or a canvas the board fills: a button labelled Start begins, and shows only while no game runs; the snake starts 5 squares long on row 4 (rows and columns from 0), on columns 1 to 5, its head at column 5, moving right one square every 200 ms; the arrow keys turn it at its next step, never straight back; past an edge it comes back on the other side; it is green (2) and the one food red (1), on a random free square; eating the food makes it one longer and puts new food down; running into itself ends the game: it stops and says Game over; a label shows Length: N
check:
# Snake that wraps, on a 10 x 10 board: the body green (2), the one food red (1); it starts 5
# long on row 4, columns 1 to 5, moving right a square every 200 ms.
click "Start"
expect squares 2 10x10 = 5
expect squares 1 10x10 = 1
expect color 1 4 10x10 = 2
expect color 3 4 10x10 = 2
expect color 5 4 10x10 = 2
expect after "length" = 5
expect not has "Start"
wait 200
expect color 6 4 10x10 = 2      # a step right
wait 1400
expect color 3 4 10x10 = 2      # 7 steps on, past the right edge: column 3
expect not says "game over"
key "down"
wait 200
expect color 3 5 10x10 = 2      # turned down
key "up"
wait 200
expect color 3 6 10x10 = 2      # never straight back
key "right"
wait 200
expect color 4 6 10x10 = 2
key "up"
wait 200
expect color 4 5 10x10 = 2
expect not says "game over"
key "left"
wait 200
expect says "game over"         # it ran into itself
expect has "Start"
mark
wait 1000
expect same                     # nothing moves once it is over
click "Start"
expect not says "game over"
expect squares 2 10x10 = 5
expect color 1 4 10x10 = 2
expect after "length" = 5

ask: a memory game: 16 cards face down on a 4 x 4 board, a grid widget or a canvas the board fills, hiding 8 pairs; the first game's pairs lie side by side, row by row (squares 0 and 1 a pair, 2 and 3, and so on), and a button labelled New game deals them again, shuffled at random; a face-down card is gray (8); a tap turns a card face up, showing its color (never gray) or symbol; tapping a card already face up does nothing; two face-up cards that match stay up, two that do not turn face down again at the next tap or after a second; it counts moves (each two cards turned is one) as Moves: N and says You win when every pair is found
check:
# Memory on a 4 x 4 board: face down gray (8), face up never gray; the first game in pairs side
# by side, row by row (squares 0 and 1 a pair, 2 and 3, ...).
expect after "moves" = 0
expect squares 8 4x4 = 16
expect not says "you win"
tapcell 0 0 4x4
expect squares 8 4x4 = 15
expect color 0 0 4x4 != 8
tapcell 0 0 4x4                 # a card face up, tapped again: nothing
expect squares 8 4x4 = 15
expect after "moves" = 0
tapcell 2 0 4x4                 # not its pair
expect after "moves" = 1
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14
wait 1500
tapcell 0 1 4x4                 # the two turned down (then, or a second after)
expect squares 8 4x4 = 15
expect color 0 0 4x4 = 8
expect color 2 0 4x4 = 8
tapcell 1 1 4x4                 # a pair stays up
expect after "moves" = 2
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14
wait 1500
tapcell 0 0 4x4
expect squares 8 4x4 = 13
tapcell 1 0 4x4
expect squares 8 4x4 = 12
wait 1500
tapcell 2 0 4x4
tapcell 3 0 4x4
tapcell 2 1 4x4
tapcell 3 1 4x4
tapcell 0 2 4x4
tapcell 1 2 4x4
tapcell 2 2 4x4
tapcell 3 2 4x4
tapcell 0 3 4x4
tapcell 1 3 4x4
tapcell 2 3 4x4
expect not says "you win"
expect squares 8 4x4 = 1
tapcell 3 3 4x4
expect squares 8 4x4 = 0
expect says "you win"
expect after "moves" = 9
click "New game"
expect squares 8 4x4 = 16
expect after "moves" = 0
expect not says "you win"
tapcell 0 0 4x4                 # one card up, then a new game: it starts afresh
click "New game"
expect squares 8 4x4 = 16
tapcell 1 0 4x4
tapcell 2 0 4x4
expect after "moves" = 1
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14

ask: a paint app: a 32 x 32 board of squares drawn with pixels on a canvas, blank at first; a tap or a drag paints the square under it in the current color; buttons labelled Red, Green, Blue and Yellow pick the color (1, 2, 4 and 3), and a label names the current color; a button labelled Clear empties the board
check:
# Paint on a 32 x 32 board of pixels: a color picked by name, a tap paints one square.
expect squares 1 32x32 = 0
expect squares 4 32x32 = 0
click "Blue"
expect says "blue"
tapcell 5 5 32x32
expect color 5 5 32x32 = 4
expect squares 4 32x32 = 1
click "Red"
expect says "red"
expect not says "blue"
tapcell 10 12 32x32
expect color 10 12 32x32 = 1
expect color 5 5 32x32 = 4
click "Yellow"
expect says "yellow"
tapcell 20 20 32x32
expect color 20 20 32x32 = 3
click "Green"
expect says "green"
tapcell 31 31 32x32
tapcell 0 0 32x32
expect color 31 31 32x32 = 2
expect color 0 0 32x32 = 2
tapcell 5 5 32x32               # painted over
expect color 5 5 32x32 = 2
expect squares 4 32x32 = 0
expect squares 2 32x32 = 3
expect squares 1 32x32 = 1
click "Clear"
expect squares 1 32x32 = 0
expect squares 2 32x32 = 0
expect squares 3 32x32 = 0
expect color 0 0 32x32 != 2
tapcell 7 9 32x32               # the color stays picked
expect color 7 9 32x32 = 2

ask: 2048 on a 4 x 4 board on a canvas: each tile a square with its number written on it as text, the empty squares gray (8) and no tile gray; every game, the first and each one a button labelled New game starts, begins with a 2 in the top left square and a 2 in the top right square; the arrow keys and buttons labelled Up, Down, Left and Right slide the tiles as far as they go; two equal tiles that meet merge into one of their sum, which adds to the score; after each move that changes the board a 2 or a 4 appears on a random empty square, and after one that changes nothing none does; it shows the score as Score N in a label above the canvas and no other numbers, and says Game over when no move is left
check:
# 2048 on a 4 x 4 board: empty squares gray (8), tiles never; every game starts with a 2 in each
# top corner. Keys and buttons both slide.
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14
expect color 0 0 4x4 != 8
expect color 3 0 4x4 != 8
expect after "score" = 0
expect not number > 2
mark
key "up"                        # nothing moves: no new tile
expect same
key "left"                      # the two 2s merge into a 4 at the left
expect after "score" = 4
expect color 0 0 4x4 != 8
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14       # the 4 and a new tile
expect number = 4
click "New game"
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14
expect after "score" = 0
expect not number > 2
click "Right"
expect after "score" = 4
expect color 3 0 4x4 != 8
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14
click "New game"
key "down"                      # both fall to the bottom row, apart
expect after "score" = 0
expect color 0 3 4x4 != 8
expect color 3 3 4x4 != 8
expect squares 8 4x4 = 13
click "New game"
mark
click "Up"
expect same
click "Left"
expect after "score" = 4
click "New game"
key "right"
expect after "score" = 4
click "New game"
click "Down"
expect squares 8 4x4 = 13
expect after "score" = 0
repeat 4: key "left"
repeat 4: click "Down"
key "right"
click "Up"
key "left"
key "down"
click "Right"
key "down"
click "Left"
key "down"
key "right"
key "up"
click "Left"
key "down"
expect not number = 3           # tiles are 2, 4, 8 ...; the score is a sum of merges
expect not number = 5
expect not number = 6
expect not number = 7
click "New game"
expect squares 8 4x4 = 14
expect after "score" = 0
expect not number > 2
